messages:
cara_research: Heads-up — I'm proposing we onboard 'zephyr-8b-v1' for a benchmarking/quantization pass this week. Need to confirm licensing, usage caps, and export constraints before we start large-scale quals. @ben_legal any quick reads?
ben_legal: Can you drop the source link and the license header? commercial vs research restriction is the big one.
cara_research: Link: https://models.example.org/zephyr/zephyr-8b-v1.zip
Cara pasted license excerpt: 
```
Zephyr Model License v1.0 — Redistribution allowed for internal commercial use; external redistribution prohibited. No military or surveillance use. Export controlled under EAR 5D992.
```
dave_infra: if EAR 5D992 is in play we should flag export-control team. Also quant builds may change binary composition — we should keep provenance for every quantized artifact.
alice_ml: For the quant run: plan is int8 dynamic + qkv packing. We'll log the exact weights and diff checksums. Any legal constraints on derived artifacts?
ben_legal: "Derived artifacts" can be tricky. If they allow internal commercial use, quantized weights used only within Redwood are fine; do NOT publish weights or provide model files to customers. Also no change that enables prohibited uses. Need a short attribution notice in the UI if we surface outputs externally.
harriet_pm: Prioritization ask: product wants fast-turn latency test for Hosted API vs Dedicated. Recommend we gate based on legal signoff + export-control confirmation. Timeline: legal signoff today, export control by EOD tomorrow, quant smoke Monday.
compliance-bot: intake created: intake-2213456789. Assigned: export-control@redwood, legal. Required docs: license-scan, CLA-check, export-check.
dave_infra: I'll create a dedicated sandbox namespace for the quant experiments (k8s: zephyr-qual). Will set network egress locked.
cara_research: thanks. Action items: 1) @ben_legal confirm allowed external surface (short text) 2) @dave_infra sandbox + artifact provenance 3) @alice_ml run int8 smoke and attach perf + regressions 4) @harriet_pm hold priority if legal/export ok.
ben_legal: Confirmed: external surface allowed only as API outputs with attribution; no weight or checkpoint sharing; include abbreviated license snippet in About & audit log. I'll post a short blurb in this thread once export team replies.
alice_ml: quick note on evals: we'll run MMLU-ish slices, safety prompt set, and our internal prod prompts. Will post results in /docs and link here.
dave_infra: sandbox ready: zephyr-qual namespace created. Upload creds to Vault path secret/zephyr/qual. Artifact naming convention: zephyr-v1-quant-{method}-{sha256}.
harriet_pm: good. Product still wants a cost estimate for Hosted latency vs Dedicated price. alice, can you get p50/p95 tokens for a 512-seq perf run?
alice_ml: yep, starting now. Posting numbers once smoke completes.
ben_legal: export-control replied via ticket 4332 — EAR 5D992 flagged but export allowed under license for internal use. No external export of model binaries. Ticket attached.
cara_research: perfect. I'll proceed with the quant smoke and small eval suite. Will tag commits and upload artifacts per provenance rules. If any regressions >3% on key prompts we stop and escalate.
harriet_pm: thanks team. Please react with :white_check_mark: when each action item done so I can close the intake.
